names.ja: アダム・ウォーロック

role_name.ja: ストラテジスト (サポート)

skills.name: Quantum Magic
skills.description: Launch quantum energy to deal damage

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 60% at 40m

description_trans.ko: 양자 에너지를 발사하여 적에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 量子エネルギーを発射して敵にダメージを与える。

skills.name: Cosmic Cluster
skills.description: Gather quantum energy into a cluster and then swiftly launch it at the enemy

stats.Casting: Charged release, with multiple delayed projectiles
stats.Fire Rate: The firing interval for a single charged shot is 0.3s, while the interval for multiple shots is 0.07s
stats.Special Effect: Cosmic Cluster shares ammo with Quantum Magic, each hit reduces the cooldown of Avatar Life Stream by 0.6s.

description_trans.ko: 양자 에너지를 구체로 응축한 뒤 전방의 적에게 신속하게 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 量子エネルギーを凝縮し、前方の敵へ素早く撃ち出す。

skills.name: Karmic Revival
skills.description: Awaken the karma of allies to revive them. Allies revived have lower health but enjoy a brief period of Invincibility

stats.Casting: Persistent spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.Special Effect: Revive allies within range, centered on Adam. Continuously monitor for fallen allies within this range; if they enter the area, they can be revived at the casting location
stats.Health Upon Revival: Allies revived will be blessed with Bonus Health equal to 70% of their Maximum Health with a 5s duration. Bonus Health falloff begins at 5s, decreasing to 0 in 2s.

description_trans.ko: 아군의 업(Karma)을 일깨워 부활시킵니다. 부활한 아군은 체력이 낮지만 잠시 동안 무적 상태가 됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 味方のカルマを目覚めさせて蘇生する。蘇生した味方は体力が低下しているが、短時間の無敵状態を得る。

skills.name: Soul Bond
skills.description: Forge a soul bond with allies, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond

stats.Special Effect 1: Adam Warlock will share a portion of the damage sustained by linked allies. If Adam Warlock sustains damage that would KO him due to the link, then the link will be broken, and he will retain 1 Health. The link will also break once enough damage is sustained, if Adam Warlock or the linked ally leave the link's range, or after a certain length of time has passed
stats.Special Effect 2: Adam can hover and attack during the ability's duration

description_trans.ko: 아군과 영혼 결속을 맺어 지속 치유를 부여하고, 결속된 팀원들이 받는 피해를 서로 분산시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: 味方とソウルボンド(魂の絆)を結び、持続回復を付与するとともに受けるダメージを分散して共有する。

skills.name: Avatar Life Stream
skills.description: Target an ally for a bouncing stream of healing energy, which also heals himself upon casting; self-targets if no ally is selected

stats.Special Effect: Bouncing target does not include Adam Warlock
stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 6s to recharge; when a critical hit lands on an enemy, reduce the cooldown time of Avatar Life Stream by 1s.

description_trans.ko: 아군을 지정해 튕겨 다니는 치유 에너지 줄기를 발사합니다. 시전 시 자신도 치유되며, 대상을 지정하지 않으면 자신에게 즉시 시전됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 味方を指定して跳弾する回復エネルギーを放ち、発動時に自身も回復する。味方未選択時は自身を対象とする。

skills.name: Karmic Revival
skills.description: Take to the skies, entering a flying state and swiftly surge forward

description_trans.ko: 하늘로 날아올라 비행 상태에 돌입하며 전방으로 신속하게 급돌진합니다.
description_trans.ja: 上空へ飛び立って飛行状態に入り、前方へ素早く急突進する。

skills.name: HEAVENLY HARMONY
skills.description: Storm channels her elemental power into Adam Warlock. When Adam uses Soaring Surge, his movement speed is increased. While flying, Adam leaves behind a storm-charged trail that heals and speeds up allies within it

description_trans.ko: 스톰이 원소의 힘을 아담 워록에게 주입합니다. 비행 돌진 시 이동 속도가 증가하며, 비행 경로에 아군을 치유하고 가속하는 폭풍 궤적을 남깁니다.
description_trans.ja: ストームが元素の力をアダム・ウォーロックに注ぎ込む。飛行突進時に移動速度が上昇し、軌跡に味方を回復・加速させる嵐の軌道を残す。

skills.name: Regenerative Cocoon
skills.description: Once his body perishes, Adam Warlock can freely move as a soul and reforge his body at a chosen spot

description_trans.ko: 육체가 쓰러지면 아담 워록은 영혼 상태로 자유롭게 이동하여 원하는 위치에서 육체를 재구성해 부활할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 肉体が滅びると、魂の状態で自由に移動し、選んだ地点で肉体を再構築して蘇生できる。

teamups.name: COSMIC CYCLONE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

description_trans.ko: 영혼 결속(Soul Bond)으로 연결된 팀원의 이동 속도가 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ソウルボンドで繋がれた味方の移動速度が上昇する。

teamups.name: COSMIC CYCLONE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

description_trans.ko: 스톰과 함께 플레이 시, 연결된 팀원의 공격력이 추가로 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ストームとチームアップ時、繋がれた味方の与ダメージがさらに上昇する。

teamups.name: FLAWLESS DESIGN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

description_trans.ko: 코스믹 클러스터(Cosmic Cluster)가 아군을 적중시키면 치유를 제공합니다.
description_trans.ja: コズミック・クラスターが味方に命中した際、回復を与えるようになる。

teamups.name: FLAWLESS DESIGN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

description_trans.ko: 울트론과 함께 플레이 시, 코스믹 클러스터가 착탄 시 폭발을 일으킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ウルトロンとチームアップ時、コズミック・クラスターが着弾時に爆発を引き起こす。

skills.name: Spear of Ichors
skills.description: Lunge forward with your spear, dealing damage that increases with Attack Charge. At full charge, Spear of Ichor can launch up enemies

stats.Special Effect: At full charge, Spear of Ichor can launch up enemies and cause 20 extra damage.

description_trans.ko: 창을 전방으로 찔러 공격 게이지(Attack Charge)에 비례한 피해를 입힙니다. 게이지가 가득 차면 적을 공중으로 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 槍を前方に突き出して攻撃チャージに応じたダメージを与える。最大チャージ時は敵を打ち上げる。

skills.name: Axes Of Ichors
skills.description: Alternate powerful strikes forward with twin axes, dealing increased damage as Attack Charge grows. The fourth strike propels you forward in a swift dash

stats.Damage: First three strikes: 30; the forth strike: 50.
stats.Attack Interval: First three strikes: 0.4s per hit; the forth strike: 0.6s per hit.
stats.Special Effect: The fourth strike propels you forward in a swift dash.

description_trans.ko: 쌍도끼로 전방을 번갈아 강타하며 공격 게이지에 따라 피해량이 증가합니다. 4타 공격 시 전방으로 신속하게 돌진합니다.
description_trans.ja: 双斧で前方を交互に強打し、攻撃チャージに応じてダメージが上昇する。4打目に高速ダッシュで前方へ突進する。

skills.name: SHIELDED STANCE
skills.description: Transform Ichors into a shield, gaining Attack Charge when absorbing damage

description_trans.ko: 이코르(Ichor)를 방패로 변환하여 피해를 흡수하며, 피해 흡수 시 공격 게이지를 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: イコルを盾に変形させてダメージを吸収し、攻撃チャージを獲得する。

skills.name: Heven's Retribution
skills.description: Wrap your spear in ribbons and hurl it with force. Upon impact, the ribbons bind nearby enemies. Angela can leap to the spear's location, damaging surrounding enemies and creating a Divine Judgement Zone

stats.Special Effect: Mobility abilities of enemies bound by the ribbons will be disabled. Enemies within a certain distance around the spear will be slowed.

description_trans.ko: 창에 리본을 감아 강력하게 투척합니다. 착탄 시 리본이 주변 적들을 결박하며, 안젤라는 창 위치로 도약하여 주변에 피해를 주고 신성한 심판 영역을 생성합니다.
description_trans.ja: 槍にリボンを巻き付けて力強く投擲する。着弾時に周囲の敵を拘束し、アンジェラは槍の位置へ跳躍して範囲ダメージを与え、神聖なる審判エリアを生成する。

skills.name: Assassin's Charge
skills.description: Enter an accelerated dash state,  enemies struck head-on are carried through the air for a short distance

stats.Special Effect: Every enemy pierced grants Angela with a 50/s passive energy recovery.

description_trans.ko: 가속 돌진 상태에 돌입하여 정면으로 충돌한 적을 잠시 공중으로 끌고 날아갑니다.
description_trans.ja: 加速ダッシュ状態に突入し、正面衝突した敵を短距離空中へ巻き込んで運ぶ。

skills.name: Divine Judgement
skills.description: Dive downward, switch to twin axes and infuse the ground with Ichors to create a Divine Judgement Zone upon impact. Within the zone, gain enhanced Speed and attacks grant Bonus Health to self and nearby allies

stats.Damage Over Time Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 8m and a height of 2m.
stats.Bonus Health: Within the Divine Judgement zone, Angela’s each Axes of Ichors hit grants 50 Bonus Health to herself and 25 Bonus Health to allies within the area.

description_trans.ko: 아래로 급강하하여 쌍도끼로 전환하고 착탄 시 지면에 이코르를 주입해 신성한 심판 영역을 생성합니다. 영역 내에서 이동 속도가 증가하고 공격 시 자신과 주변 아군에게 추가 체력을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 急降下して双斧に切り替え、着地時に地面にイコルを注入して神聖なる審判エリアを展開する。エリア内では移動速度が上昇し、攻撃時に自身と周囲の味方へ追加体力を付与する。

skills.name: Wingblade Ascent
skills.description: Take to the skies, switching back to Spear of Ichors

description_trans.ko: 하늘로 치솟아 오르며 이코르의 창으로 다시 전환합니다.
description_trans.ja: 上空へ飛び上がり、再びイコルの槍へと切り替える。

skills.name: Seraphic Soar
skills.description: Glide freely through the air. Continuous flight builds Attack Charge

stats.Glide Activation Condition: Maintain the forward speed faster than 5m/s for 1s

description_trans.ko: 공중을 자유롭게 활공합니다. 비행을 지속할수록 공격 게이지가 서서히 충전됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 空中を自在に滑空する。滑空を維持することで攻撃チャージが徐々に蓄積される。

skills.name: Celestial Command
skills.description: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

description_trans.ko: 안젤라가 토르에게 이코르 파편을 공유하여, 적중한 적마다 토르포스를 회복하는 번개의 창을 투척할 수 있게 합니다. 이후 토르는 창의 폭발 지점으로 도약하여 범위 내 모든 적에게 2차 피해를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: アンジェラがソーにイコルの破片を分け与え、命中した敵ごとにソーフォースを回復する雷の槍を投擲できるようにする。その後、ソーは槍の爆発地点へ跳躍し、範囲内の全敵へ2次ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: ASGARDIANS OF THE GALAXY
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 시 목표 영역 내의 적을 탐지(Reveal)합니다. 스킬을 재입력하면 강타 공격을 가하며, 적중당한 적은 지상으로 추락(Grounded)합니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動時に指定エリア内の敵を探知する。再発動で叩きつけ攻撃を行い、命中した敵を接地(飛行不可)状態にする。

teamups.name: ASGARDIANS OF THE GALAXY
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

stats.Bonus Health: Gain 75 Bonus Health per target hit, up to 200

description_trans.ko: 스타로드와 함께 플레이 시, 강타 공격에 적중당한 적 수에 비례하여 안젤라가 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: スター・ロードとチームアップ時、叩きつけ攻撃が命中した敵の数に応じてアンジェラが追加体力を獲得する。

teamups.name: ODIN'S UNACKNOWLEDGED
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 환영을 투사합니다. 환영은 암살자의 돌진(Assassin's Charge)을 사용하여 전방의 적을 들이받으며, 정면으로 충돌한 적을 잠시 공중으로 끌고 갑니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ幻影を投射する。幻影はアサシン・チャージを繰り出して敵に突進し、正面衝突した敵を短時間空中へ巻き込む。

teamups.name: ODIN'S UNACKNOWLEDGED
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

stats.Special Effect: The ability gains 2 charges

description_trans.ko: 로키와 함께 플레이 시, 이 스킬의 충전 횟수가 2회로 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ロキとチームアップ時、スキルのチャージ数が2回に増加する。

skills.name: FELINE FURY
skills.description: Swipe forward with razor-sharp claws

description_trans.ko: 날카로운 발톱으로 전방을 빠르게 할퀴어 공격합니다.
description_trans.ja: 鋭利な鉤爪で前方を素早く切り裂く。

skills.name: FORTUNE'S FAVOR
skills.description: Spend Fortuneto unleash either Grapple Swipeor Phantom Pursuit

description_trans.ko: 행운(Fortune)을 소모하여 그래플 스와이프 또는 팬텀 퍼슈트를 발동합니다.
description_trans.ja: 幸運(フォーチュン)を消費してグラップルスワイプまたはファントムパシュートを発動する。

skills.name: CALLING CARD
skills.description: Issue a Calling Card to all enemies. Instantly dash to any enemy in sight and range, tearing into them with your claws to deal Damage

description_trans.ko: 모든 적에게 예고장을 보냅니다. 시야와 사거리 내의 임의의 적에게 즉시 질주하여 발톱으로 찢어발기며 큰 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: 全敵に予告状を放つ。視界と射程内の任意の敵へ即座にダッシュし、爪で切り裂いて大ダメージを与える。

skills.name: CAT'S CRADLE
skills.description: Lunge forward with claws bared, slicing through any enemies caught in your path

stats.Cooldown: 1 charges, with each charge taking 8s to recharge

description_trans.ko: 발톱을 드러내고 전방으로 돌진하여 경로상의 모든 적을 베고 지나갑니다.
description_trans.ja: 爪を剥き出しにして前方に飛び込み、進路上の敵を切り裂く。

skills.name: TURN OF FORTUNE
skills.description: Launch a grappling hook forward that damages an enemy on impact and steals Fortunebefore pulling it back to Black Cat

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 갈고리를 발사해 명중한 적에게 피해를 주고 행운을 훔쳐낸 뒤 블랙 캣에게 회수합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へグラップリングフックを放ち、着弾した敵にダメージを与えて幸運を奪い、自身の手元へ引き戻す。

skills.name: THIEVING GRACE
skills.description: Perform a double jump

description_trans.ko: BLACK CAT의 스킬입니다. Perform a double jump.
description_trans.ja: BLACK CATのスキル。Perform a double jump。

skills.name: STEALTHY CATWALK
skills.description: Hold {Jump} to crawl up vertical surfaces

description_trans.ko: BLACK CAT의 스킬입니다. Hold {Jump} to crawl up vertical surfaces.
description_trans.ja: BLACK CATのスキル。Hold {Jump} to crawl up vertical surfaces。

skills.name: MALKIN MISFORTUNE
skills.description: Apply Jinxto enemies on hit. Jinxedfoes have a chance to lose their bonus damage when striking Black Cat with a Critical Hit

description_trans.ko: BLACK CAT의 스킬입니다. Apply Jinxto 적들 on hit. Jinxedfoes have a chance to lose their bonus damage when striking Black Cat with a 치명타.
description_trans.ja: BLACK CATのスキル。Apply Jinxto 敵 on hit. Jinxedfoes have a chance to lose their bonus damage when striking Black Cat with a クリティカル。

skills.name: GIFT OF GOLD
skills.description: Black Cat shares items acquired from Insider Trading with White Fox and Captain America. White Fox receives the Life Orb, which restores Spirit Fox Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Radiance that auto-tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting allies speed and healing while dealing damage and slowing enemies. Captain America receives the Vibranium Energy Amplifier, which expands shield block range when raised and reflects projectiles back along the crosshair direction.

description_trans.ko: BLACK CAT의 스킬입니다. Black Cat shares items acquired from Insider Trading with White Fox and Captain America. White Fox receives the Life Orb, which restores Spirit Fox Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Radiance that auto-tracks nearby 아군 and 적들, granting 아군 speed and healing while 피해를 입히며 and 적들을 감속시키며. Captain America receives the Vibranium Energy Amplifier, which expands 보호막 block range when raised and reflects 투사체 back along the crosshair direction.
description_trans.ja: BLACK CATのスキル。Black Cat shares items acquired from Insider Trading with White Fox and Captain America. White Fox receives the Life Orb, which restores Spirit Fox Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Radiance that auto-tracks nearby 味方 and 敵, granting 味方 speed and healing while ダメージを与え and 敵を減速させ. Captain America receives the Vibranium Energy Amplifier, which expands シールド block range when raised and reflects 弾丸 back along the crosshair direction.。

teamups.name: FELINE ALLIANCE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Taking damage accumulates Vibranium Energy. Upon reaching a specific threshold, Black Cat can unleash a violent explosion, damaging and Knocking back surrounding enemies while gaining a brief Speed Boost and Bonus Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

description_trans.ko: 피해를 입으면 비브라늄 에너지가 축적됩니다. 특정 임계치에 도달하면 폭발을 일으켜 주변 적에게 피해를 주고 밀쳐내며, 잠시 이동 속도 증가와 추가 체력을 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: 被ダメージ時にヴィブラニウム・エネルギーが蓄積する。一定閾値に達すると爆発を放ち、周囲の敵にダメージとノックバックを与えつつ、一時的な移動速度上昇と追加体力を獲得する。

teamups.name: FELINE ALLIANCE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Taking damage accumulates Vibranium Energy. Upon reaching a specific threshold, Black Cat can unleash a violent explosion, damaging and Knocking back surrounding enemies while gaining a brief Speed Boost and Bonus Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

stats.Special Effect: No longer limited by energy accumulation ratio; can be cast anytime

description_trans.ko: 블랙 팬서와 함께 플레이 시, 이 폭발이 에너지 임계치 제한 없이 언제든 즉시 발동 가능해집니다.

The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay

description_trans.ko: Gambit의 스킬입니다. Gambit charges Magneto's greatsword with kinetic energy. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking 적들. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking 敵. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay。

teamups.name: FAVORABLE ODDS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the two cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launchingenemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the two cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

description_trans.ko: 키네틱 카드를 연속 투척할 때마다 치명타 확률이 점진적으로 상승합니다.
description_trans.ja: キネティックカードを連続投擲するたびにクリティカル率が段階的に上昇する。

description_trans.ko: 로그와 함께 플레이 시, 서로의 호흡이 맞춰져 로그에게 키네틱 차징 능력을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ローグとチームアップ時、抜群の呼吸が合わさり、ローグにキネティックチャージ能力を付与する。

teamups.name: SPARKLING STAFF
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Twirl your firework-energy enhanced bo staff. The radiating firework sparks provide healing to nearby allies. Concurrently, the staff deals damage to close-range enemies, and the rapid spinning blocks incoming damage from most projectiles.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, both Bayou Bashand Big Easy Impactgain an additional Continuous Healingaura.

description_trans.ko: 봉 공격으로 지면을 내리칠 때 전방으로 키네틱 충격파를 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 棍棒攻撃で地面を叩いた際、前方へキネティック衝撃波を放つ。

description_trans.ko: 쥬빌리와 함께 플레이 시, 폭죽 불꽃놀이 에너지가 봉 끝에 장전되어 눈부신 불꽃 폭발을 일으킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ジュビリーとチームアップ時、花火エネルギーが棍の先端に宿り、眩い閃光爆発を発生させる。

skills.name: Kinetic Cards
skills.description: Launch three kinetic-charged cards in an arc ahead. Each card detonates on impact, creating a single-target explosion that damages enemies and heals allies

stats.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory

description_trans.ko: Gambit의 스킬입니다. Launch three kinetic-charged cards in an arc ahead. Each card detonates on impact, creating a single-target explosion that damages 적들 and 아군을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: Gambitのスキル。Launch three kinetic-charged cards in an arc ahead. Each card detonates on impact, creating a single-target explosion that damages 敵 and 味方を回復する。

skills.description: Channel kinetic energy into the bo staff, then slam it into the ground after a sweeping strike, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and heals allies

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 8s to recharge

description_trans.ko: Gambit의 스킬입니다. Channel kinetic energy into the bo staff, then slam it into the ground after a sweeping strike, creating a shockwave that damages nearby 적들 and 아군을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: Gambitのスキル。Channel kinetic energy into the bo staff, then slam it into the ground after a sweeping strike, creating a shockwave that damages nearby 敵 and 味方を回復する。

skills.description: Lock onto an ally within sight and unleash multiple Aces that heal and Purify. Both enter the Kinetic Transfer state, granting increased Movement Speed and Jump Boost, while enhancing attacks with additional single-target explosive damage and providing the ally with Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration

stats.Range: Cone shape spell field, angle range: 110°, length: 40m
stats.Special Effect: Gambit and the targeted ally receive the Purify and Jump Boost effect.

Both enter the Kinetic Transfer state, granting increased 移動速度 and Jump Boost, while enhancing attacks with additional single-target explosive damage and providing the 味方 with Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration。

stats.Cooldown: 4 charges, with each charge taking 8s to recharge.
stats.Self Healing: Heal 30 health per second within duration
stats.Special Effect: Within the duration, consume one stack of Sleight of Hand to use Bridge Boost and Purifying Pick-Up.

description_trans.ko: Gambit의 스킬입니다. Conjure a Heart card by consuming one stack of Sleight of Hand to Heal and switch to the Healing Hearts deck.
description_trans.ja: Gambitのスキル。Conjure a Heart card by consuming one stack of Sleight of Hand to Heal and switch to the Healing Hearts deck。

skills.name: Bridge Boost
skills.description: While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to card spring and fire a full deck forward. Cards bounce between allies on impact, granting Health and a Healing Boost

stats.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory.
stats.Special Effect: The projectile automatically tracks allies and will bounce between allies on impact. Bridge Boost bounces on a single target are set to a maximum of 2

description_trans.ko: Gambit의 스킬입니다. While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to card spring and fire a full deck forward. Cards bounce between 아군 on impact, granting Health and a Healing Boost.
description_trans.ja: Gambitのスキル。While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to card spring and fire a full deck forward. Cards bounce between 味方 on impact, granting Health and a Healing Boost。

stats.Casting: Projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.Special Effect: Launch enemies up on hit, which can take effect only once.

description_trans.ko: Gambit의 스킬입니다. While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to scattering cards in an arc in all directions. Explosions damage 적들 and Launch them up.
description_trans.ja: Gambitのスキル。While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to scattering cards in an arc in all directions. Explosions damage 敵 and Launch them up。

description_trans.ko: Gambit의 스킬입니다. While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to launch a cluster of cards in an arc ahead. Explosions heal nearby 아군 and Purify them.

description_trans.ja: Gambitのスキル。While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to fire a full set of cards forward. Cards explode on impact, ダメージを与え while inflicting Reduced Healing。

skills.name: All-Black
skills.description: Unleash up to a 4-strike rapid combo with All-Black the Necrosword

stats.Damage: 40 for the 1st/3rd hits, 60 for the 2nd/4th hits
stats.Attack Interval: 0.4s for the 1st/3rd hits, 0.6s for the 2nd/4th hits

description_trans.ko: 올블랙 네크로소드로 최대 4타의 연속 베기 콤보를 펼칩니다.
description_trans.ja: オールブラック・ネクロソードで最大4連続の斬撃コンボを繰り出す。

skills.name: Necro-Power
skills.description: Charge and launch a symbiote mass forward. Hitting an enemy Slows and teleports nearby Black Berserkers to them, or spawns a new one. Arriving Berserkers unleash a two-strike melee attack to Launch Up nearby enemies before reverting to ranged mode

description_trans.ko: 심비오트 덩어리를 충전하여 전방으로 발사합니다. 적에게 명중 시 둔화를 부여하고 주변의 블랙 버서커를 해당 위치로 순간이동시키거나 새로 소환합니다. 도착한 버서커는 2회 연속 근접 공격으로 주변 적을 띄운 뒤 원거리 모드로 전환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: シンビオートの塊をチャージして前方へ発射する。敵に命中するとスロウを付与し、周囲のブラック・バーサーカーをその位置へテレポートさせるか、新たに召喚する。到着したバーサーカーは2連撃の近接攻撃で周囲の敵を打ち上げた後、遠距離モードに戻る。

skills.name: Twilight of the Gods
skills.description: Unseal All-Black's true power, transforming it into the Annihilablade. Upon activation, an expanding Necroverse is formed, instantly spawning a Black Berserker next to all enemies caught inside. While active, every slash of the Annihilablade deals devastating damage. The Necroverse moves with Gorr; Berserkers within the field will not expire and remain locked in a perpetual Frenzied State

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 80% at 10m

description_trans.ko: 올블랙의 진정한 힘을 해방하여 파멸도(Annihilablade)로 변형합니다. 시전 시 팽창하는 네크로버스가 형성되며 내부의 모든 적 옆에 블랙 버서커가 즉시 소환됩니다. 활성화 동안 파멸도의 모든 베기가 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다. 네크로버스는 고르를 따라 이동하며, 영역 내 버서커는 지속시간이 만료되지 않고 영구 광폭 상태를 유지합니다.
description_trans.ja: オールブラックの真の力を解放し、アナイアブレードへと変形させる。発動時に拡大するネクロバースが展開され、内部の全敵の隣にブラック・バーサーカーが即座に召喚される。有効中、アナイアブレードの斬撃は壊滅的なダメージを与える。ネクロバースはゴアと共に移動し、領域内のバーサーカーは消滅せず永続的な狂乱状態を維持する。

skills.name: Living Abyss
skills.description: Surge forward as an Invincible symbiote mass, leaving a Black Berserker behind and driving all active Berserkers into a Frenzied State. Upon landing, manifest a Necroverse that continuously damages trapped enemies, converting them into Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 무적 상태의 심비오트 덩어리가 되어 전방으로 돌진하며, 지나간 자리에 블랙 버서커를 남기고 모든 버서커를 광폭 상태로 만듭니다. 착지 시 네크로버스를 형성해 갇힌 적들에게 지속 피해를 입히고 추가 체력으로 흡수합니다.
description_trans.ja: 無敵状態のシンビオート塊となって前方へ突進し、通過地点にブラック・バーサーカーを残して全バーサーカーを狂乱状態にする。着地時にネクロバースを展開し、閉じ込めた敵へ持続ダメージを与えて追加体力へと変換する。

skills.name: Black Berserker
skills.description: Lob a symbiote mass that spawns a Black Berserker on landing to immediately shoot the nearest enemy. If summoned beside an enemy via Necro-Power, it unleashes a two-strike melee attack instead

description_trans.ko: 심비오트 덩어리를 투척하여 착탄 위치에 블랙 버서커를 소환합니다. 버서커는 즉시 가장 가까운 적을 사격하며, 네크로-파워를 통해 적 옆에 소환될 경우 2회 연속 근접 공격을 대신 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: シンビオート塊を投擲し、着弾地点にブラック・バーサーカーを召喚して最も近い敵を即座に射撃する。ネクロ・パワーで敵の隣に召喚された場合は、代わりに2連続近接攻撃を繰り出す。

skills.name: Shadow Harvest
skills.description: Warp to a selected Black Berserker, sacrificing it for Bonus Health equal to half its Health and triggering a symbiote explosion. Briefly unlocks Shadow Scythe: fire a piercing shockwave forward. All-Black then becomes a scythe for a set duration or 4 slashes

stats.Bonus Health: 50% of the Black Berserker's remaining Health, up to 50; shares the Bonus Health cap with Berserker Swarm

description_trans.ko: 선택한 블랙 버서커에게 순간이동하여 희생시키며, 버서커 체력의 절반에 해당하는 추가 체력을 얻고 심비오트 폭발을 일으킵니다. 잠시 그림자 낫(Shadow Scythe)이 해금되어 전방으로 관통 충격파를 발사하며, 올블랙이 일정 시간 또는 4회 공격 동안 대낫 형태로 변형됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 選択したブラック・バーサーカーの位置へワープして生贄にし、その体力の半分に相当する追加体力を獲得してシンビオート爆発を起こす。一時的にシャドウサイスが解放され、前方へ貫通衝撃波を発射する。その後オールブラックは一定時間または4回の斬撃まで大鎌形態へと変化する。

skills.name: Berserker Swarm
skills.description: Black Berserker damage grants Gorr Bonus Health. Defeating an enemy instantly spawns a Black Berserker at their location

stats.Summon Damage/Health Conversion: 100%, up to 50; shares the Bonus Health cap with Shadow Harvest

description_trans.ko: 블랙 버서커가 적에게 피해를 입히면 고르가 추가 체력을 획득합니다. 적을 처치하면 처치된 위치에 즉시 블랙 버서커가 소환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラック・バーサーカーがダメージを与えるとゴアが追加体力を獲得する。敵を撃破すると、その位置に即座にブラック・バーサーカーが召喚される。

teamups.name: Ragnarök
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to morph the All-Black into a scythe and execute a sweeping strike, damaging and briefly Grounding nearby enemies. The weapon stays in scythe form for a short duration.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, the scythe's attack range is expanded. Each hit scatters symbiote fragments, granting Bonus Health to Gorr and nearby allies

description_trans.ko: 올블랙을 대낫으로 변형해 회전 베기를 가하여 주변 적에게 피해를 주고 잠시 착지 상태로 만드는 새 능력을 얻습니다. 무기는 잠시 대낫 형태를 유지합니다.
description_trans.ja: オールブラックを大鎌に変形させて薙ぎ払い、周囲の敵にダメージを与えて短時間拘束(接地)させる新アビリティを獲得する。武器は短時間大鎌形態を維持する。

teamups.name: Ragnarök
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to morph the All-Black into a scythe and execute a sweeping strike, damaging and briefly Grounding nearby enemies. The weapon stays in scythe form for a short duration.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, the scythe's attack range is expanded. Each hit scatters symbiote fragments, granting Bonus Health to Gorr and nearby allies

description_trans.ko: 헬라와 함께 플레이 시 대낫의 공격 범위가 확장됩니다. 적을 맞출 때마다 심비오트 파편이 흩어져 고르와 주변 아군에게 추가 체력을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラとチームアップ時、大鎌の攻撃範囲が拡大する。命中ごとにシンビオートの破片が散らばり、ゴアと周囲の味方に追加体力を付与する。

teamups.name: Hive Mind
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to fire a Symbiote Claw forward, dealing piercing damage to enemies in its path. Upon reaching max distance, it retracts, Launching caught enemies toward Gorr.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Black Berserkers receive a slight Damage Boost and apply a Slow effect to enemies they strike

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 심비오트 클로를 발사하여 경로 상의 적에게 관통 피해를 주는 새 능력을 얻습니다. 최대 사거리에 도달하면 회수되며 잡힌 적을 고르 쪽으로 끌어당깁니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へシンビオート・クローを発射し、直線上の敵へ貫通ダメージを与える新アビリティを獲得する。最大距離に達すると巻き戻り、捕らえた敵をゴアの元へ引き寄せる。

teamups.name: Hive Mind
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to fire a Symbiote Claw forward, dealing piercing damage to enemies in its path. Upon reaching max distance, it retracts, Launching caught enemies toward Gorr.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Black Berserkers receive a slight Damage Boost and apply a Slow effect to enemies they strike

description_trans.ko: 베놈과 함께 플레이 시 블랙 버서커가 약간의 피해 증가 효과를 얻고 타격한 적에게 둔화를 적용합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムとチームアップ時、ブラック・バーサーカーのダメージがわずかに上昇し、攻撃した敵へスロウを付与する。

skills.name: Piercing Arrow
skills.description: Shoot a powerful arrow

stats.Casting: Charged projectile with an arced trajectory
stats.Projectile Speed: 130 - 195 m/s (Maximum speed is achieved after 0.9s of charging)
stats.Damage: 28 - 70 (Maximum damage is achieved after 0.9s of charging)

description_trans.ko: HAWKEYE의 스킬입니다. Shoot a powerful arrow.
description_trans.ja: HAWKEYEのスキル。Shoot a powerful arrow。

skills.description: Shoot three explosive arrows

stats.Casting: Arced projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

description_trans.ko: HAWKEYE의 스킬입니다. Shoot three explosive arrows.
description_trans.ja: HAWKEYEのスキル。Shoot three explosive arrows。

skills.name: Hunter's Sight
skills.description: Capture Afterimages of enemies in his view. Damage dealt to an Afterimage is transferred to the corresponding enemy

stats.Special Mechanic: While Hunter's Sight is active, bow draw speed is increased

description_trans.ko: HAWKEYE의 스킬입니다. Capture Afterimages of 적들 in his view. Damage dealt to an Afterimage is transferred to the corresponding 적.
description_trans.ja: HAWKEYEのスキル。Capture Afterimages of 敵 in his view. Damage dealt to an Afterimage is transferred to the corresponding 敵。

skills.name: Crescent Slash
skills.description: Unsheathe a katana and slash forward, launching up enemies hit
